title: Joinery Installation
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Timber moisture 8–12% and storage conditions logged?
questions.source: Atlantic ITP – temperature, humidity & moisture check

questions.q: Are datum levels set and background surfaces within tolerance?
Is joinery plumb, level and in line, within tolerance?
Is there at least a 10 mm perimeter gap (plus 2 mm per metre run) where required?
Are fixings accurate and concealed, with cantilevers no more than 150 mm?
Is the work protected and free from damage?
Mastic depth at least 10 mm where joinery is sealed?
